Un {d}as der rebbe singt, un as der rebbe singt, {g}singen alle cha{d}sidim, {g}singen alle {d}chasidim:
{A}Lalalalala, {d}lalalalala, {A}singen alle cha{d}sid{D}im. {g}Lalalalala, {d}lalalalala, {A}singen alle {d}chasidim.

Un as der rebbe tantzt ... Hophophophophop

Un as der rebbe wejnt ... Ojojojojoj

Un as der rebbe lacht ... Hahahahaha

Un as der rebbe isst ... Mjamjamjamjam

Un as der rebbe trinkt ... Gluckgluckgluckgluckgluck

Un as der rebbe pfeift ... 

Un as der rebbe schwajgt ...
title: As der rebbe
